question:
‘P @ Q’ means ‘P is the sister of Q’

‘P & Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’

‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’

If ‘A # B @ C # D @ E & F’, then how is D related to F?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbe949c88b7ad8655c0f554c90c173f35e5c348f1820bc7c131790e158710e90.png] 

 Given:

‘P @ Q’ means ‘P is the sister of Q’

‘P & Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’

‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

Given: ‘**A # B @ C # D @ E & F**’

1) A # B

'A # B’ means 'A is the mother of B'.

2) B @ C

'B @ C' means 'B is sister of C'.

3) C # D

'C # D' means 'C is mother of D'.

4) D @ E

'D @ E' means 'D is sister of E'.

5) E & F

'E & F’ means 'E is son of F'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42a55133bf1f0532a07e364d976b5186c1bd01f0b02fb2c41429eaae22dee6f9.png] 

Hence, D is the 'daughter' of F.
